lede: Mountain Village Council meets Wednesday with a resolution that sets the appreciation cap on deed-restricted units — the fine print that determines whether affordable housing actually stays affordable or quietly slips out of reach. The same day, HARC takes up the Shandoka Lot redevelopment on Black Bear Road for preliminary large-scale review across four buildings, and the Ouray County Planning Commission holds three public hearings including a full repeal of Section 16 of its land use regulations, a code change with wide ripple effects. Parks and Rec also weighs in on proposed 2027 campground and shower fee increases that will affect locals and visitors alike.
